title_en: Elite villa for sale on the edge of Lake Farka!
description_en: Elite villa for sale on the edge of Lake Farka! Elite villa for sale on the edge of Lake Farka! - Rolling Hills Liqeni, a new project, currently under construction on the edge of Farka Lake Conceived as a modern residential complex, Rolling Hills Liqeni includes premium villas and apartments, a Piazza with all the necessary services as well as a Recreational Park with spaces dedicated to relaxation and entertainment for all ages. - The villa is designed with ample spaces in every environment. Based on the French neoclassical architecture, they have been treated with a new contemporary spirit and a strong emphasis on the quality of construction. - Living area 273m2, 2 floors above ground, one floor underground, 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, wardrobe, laundry, etc. - Land area 337m2, above. yard 245m2, 2 parking spaces, for more information contact!
